'''Wicket''' was an inquisitive and fearless nature spirit [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology, honored by explorers. "Wicket" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
